title: Rung: Navier-Stokes from a $3+1$ projection of the conserved current

statements.text: A spatial projection of the four-dimensional continuity system defines fluid variables and an exact reduced equation with extra constitutive and residual terms. The classical incompressible Navier-Stokes equation is recovered only after those terms are truncated.

sources.quote: A spatial projection defines effective fluid variables and yields an exact reduced equation containing additional constitutive and residual terms.
The classical incompressible Navier– Stokes equation is recovered only after truncation of these terms.
